newsitem.title: USA: Domenici sees basis for further U.S. budget talks.
newsitem.headline: Domenici sees basis for further U.S. budget talks.

text.p: Senate Budget Committee Chairman Pete Domenici said Thursday that enough progress has been made in current talks with the White House and Congress on a budget deal that discussions should continue.
Domenici told reporters after a speech to the Economic Strategy Institute that this was a "make or break" week for efforts to get a deal with the White House to balance the budget.
He said enough has been accomplished in the discusions that "deliberations should continue."

The New Mexico Republican said that Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin and Secretary of State Madeleine Albright would be talking with Congressional budget negotiators about foreign policy spending and other issues in talks Thursday afternoon.

Domenici said he spoke with President Clinton Wednesday evening during a White House dinner with members of Congress on foreign policy issues. He said he sat next to the President but declined to discuss the nature of their talks on the budget.
